```python
import re
from collections import Counter

def normalize(s):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z ]", "", s)).lower().strip()

def trigrams(s):
    s = normalize(s)
    tokens = s.split()
    return [tuple(tokens[i:i+3]) for i in range(len(tokens)-2)]

def jaccard(set_a, set_b):
    A, B = set(set_a), set(set_b)
    inter = len(A & B)
    union = len(A | B)
    return inter / union if union else 0.0

partial = "In one of the Bards best thought of tragedies our insistent hero Hamlet queries on two fronts about"

candidates = [
    "To be or not to be",
    "To be or not to be that is the question",
    "Whether tis nobler in the mind to suffer",
    "The slings and arrows of outrageous fortune",
    "Or to take arms against a sea of troubles",
]

base_trigrams = trigrams(partial)
for c in candidates:
    score = jaccard(base_trigrams, trigrams(c))
    print(f"{c} -> {score:.4f}")
```
